description: Get who bought and sold a specific token in a given period, ranked by net USD. tab=bought lists the top NET buyers (bought more than sold), tab=sold the top NET sellers, largest first, with quantities and USD values. Wallets that only pass the token through (routers, pools: bought ~= sold) are not listed; a row can still be a contract (a pool, vault or settlement contract), and `title` names the known ones; `hide_contracts` leaves out the contracts we know of. bought / sold / net_tokens are whole tokens, usd_spent / usd_received USD. net_usd = usd_received - usd_spent, so a net buyer's is NEGATIVE: its net USD bought is -net_usd.

hide_contracts.description: Leave out the contracts we know of (the website's 'Hide pools & routers'): wallets labelled as a pool, router, vault, bridge or staking contract, and addresses with contract code that bought and sold within 1% of each other (pass-through). Contract code is checked only for the wallets our pages rank, so a contract outside that set can still appear; one that mostly buys or sells (a vault, a smart wallet) stays. Default false.

max_amount.description: Count only transfers of at most this many tokens (whole tokens, not raw units, up to 1e18). Applied to each transfer BEFORE a wallet's totals are summed, so bought, sold and the USD columns add up only those transfers and a wallet ranks on them alone. Omit for no ceiling

min_amount.description: Count only transfers of at least this many tokens (whole tokens, not raw units, up to 1e18). Applied to each transfer BEFORE a wallet's totals are summed, so bought, sold and the USD columns add up only those transfers and a wallet ranks on them alone. Omit for no floor

tab.description: Net buyers or net sellers (default sold)

name: token_transfers
title: Token Transfers
